mapper.sql: id, name, description, price, stock, image, category_id, merchant_id, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into product(name, description, price, stock, image, category_id, merchant_id, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{image}, #{categoryId}, #{merchantId}, #{status}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update product set name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, image = #{image}, category_id = #{categoryId}, merchant_id = #{merchantId}, status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
